Batch 12 is constructed and recorded. Summary of what was done and the state on disk:

## Deliverables written (batch 12 only)

- `research/frontier-38-owner-30-batch-12.pages.json` — the owned A/B pair at orders 529/530, unchanged `id`/`kind`/`category`/`title`/`companion`/`requires`, with **20 A items + 5 B items**, each with statement, proof strategy, explicit `deps`, `dependency_level`, provenance and source locators.
- `research/frontier-38-owner-30-batch-12.coverage.json` — 3 full treatments per page (GP, Milnor, Stanford 215B), 51 harvest rows all dispositioned (36 included/inline, 13 deferred to DT‑12/13/15/18, 2 out-of-scope with reasons), 6/6 `fetch_verified` stamps.
- `research/frontier-38-owner-30-batch-12.notes.md` — scope/plan comparison, inventory, dependency audit, source record, check results, unresolved findings.
- `research/frontier-38-owner-30-batch-12.cross-batch-dependencies.json` — `[]` (no in-run suppliers or consumers; all six page prereqs are published out-of-run pages).
- 25 `research/frontier-38-owner-30-step1-<item>.json` readiness records — all `ready`, none escalated.

## Mathematical closure

The design's 16+5 claims are preserved verbatim in order. Four local prerequisites were added because the corpus lacked them: the Milnor arc-length overlap lemma, the compact-1-manifold classification + even boundary (design item 4), the oriented 1-manifold boundary-count cancellation (Milnor Lemma 1), the transverse-preimage-for-manifolds-with-boundary trace lemma, and the direct-sum factor-swap sign. Dependency levels 0–7 were recomputed and verified; 61 distinct external deps all resolve to published, read items; Countable Choice is declared with its exact use (transversality/Whitney/metric/slice charts) and nowhere else.

## Checks actually run

- `manifest-deps` (batch and whole-run): 0 missing, 0 errors; `content-policy --manifest-only` (batch and whole-run): 0 errors/warnings.
- `coverage-checklist --require-destination`: 2 pages, 51 harvested, 0 errors/warnings.
- `source-fetch-check --stamp` → 6/6 stamped, check mode 6/6 resolved; `url-sweep`: 3/3 live.
- `step1-decisions check`: 0 work rows mention any batch-12 item; `item-dependency-levels check`: all error lines are other batches' empty scaffolds, none ours.
- `frontier-dependency-ledger refresh`: batch-12 input reviewed; `manifest-integrity`: no scope drift; `drift-review-check`: no blocked edges; `validate-plan` and `extcheck`: exit 0 (extcheck's 40 warnings are pre-existing published remarks elsewhere).

## Honest caveats recorded

1. **Hirsch (design's `[H]`) could not be read here**: the design URL 404s, and the three alternate copies found are image-only scans without text layers (attempts and outcomes recorded in the notes). The pair is backed instead by three independently verified treatments (GP, Milnor, Stanford), so no escalation was needed; the unverified locator is on the record for owner reconciliation.
2. **Trace-sign convention** (`lem-oriented-boundary-of-an-intersection-trace-has-opposite-end-signs`): the sign relation is the GP p. 108 / Milnor Lemma 1 computation and is flagged in the notes as the load-bearing convention check for Step 3, with the normal-first convention fixed explicitly in the preimage-orientation item.
3. Readiness records are provisional (hash-bound, mechanically invalidated by later edits); Step 3 supplies the mathematical review.
